name: Email every campaign reply to the owner of that campaign

parameters.content:
## Email every campaign reply to the owner of that campaign

### How it works
Send each reply to the person who owns the campaign. When a reply arrives (new or marked Interested), the workflow reads the campaign, takes its tags and matches them against a small owner table you edit in one place. The reply goes by email to the matching owner, or to your default address when no tag matches.

No credits are used. Out of office and other automatic replies are left out by Argorant.

### Setup
1. Install the community node **n8n-nodes-argorant** (tested with 0.3.0 on n8n 2.46.6): Settings > Community nodes > Install. Guide: https://github.com/argorant/n8n-nodes-argorant
2. Add an **Argorant API** credential with a key from Argorant (Settings, API keys).
3. Activate the trigger with your Argorant credential. Argorant webhooks come with the Pro plan, and your n8n needs a public HTTPS address.
4. Edit **Owners**: one line per campaign tag with the owner's email, plus a default address.
5. Tag your campaigns in Argorant with those tags.
6. Add a Gmail credential to **Email the owner**.

### Customization
Add more lines to the owner table, or send a team chat message instead of an email.

## Match the owner
Campaign tags decide who gets the reply. Edit the table in Owners only.
